translation.在控制台查看调用记录、用量和费用明细。: View requests, usage and cost details in the console.
translation.多模型统一接入，让开发与创作更方便。: Unified model access for development and creativity.
translation.点击统计加载失败，请刷新重试: Could not load clicks. Refresh to retry.
translation.用 AI，不必东奔西找: Your AI models, all in one place
translation.统一接入多种 AI 模型，按任务选择合适的能力。: Access multiple AI models and choose what fits each task.
translation.通过 API 连接应用与开发工具，减少重复接入。: Connect apps and developer tools through an API with less integration work.
translation.邀请链接不可用，请刷新页面后重试: Invitation link unavailable. Refresh and try again.
translation.复制到博客或网站即可展示，已包含你的邀请码。修改邀请码后，请同步更新已投放的代码: Paste into a blog or website. Your invite code is included; update published ads if you change it.
translation.仅统计功能上线后的短邀请链接访问；重复访问可能计入，不代表独立访客或注册人数。: Counts short invitation link visits since tracking launched. Repeat visits may count; these are not unique visitors or registrations.
translation.预览不产生点击统计；实际嵌入网站后，访问广告链接才计数。: Preview does not count clicks. Visits to the ad link on your website are counted.
translation.满血 CC Max、GPT Pro，让灵感变成作品，让想法跑成代码。: Full-powered CC Max and GPT Pro. Turn inspiration into work and ideas into code.
translation.从第一行代码，到整个项目。: From your first line to a whole project.
translation.满血 CC Max、GPT Pro，一站接入。: Full-powered CC Max and GPT Pro, in one place.
translation.优先使用所选分组；不可用时按后台顺序尝试其他可用分组，按实际使用分组计费。关闭后: Use the selected group first. If unavailable, try other available groups in the configured order and bill at the group actually used. When off, only use the selected group.
translation.首选分组不可用时自动切组，按实际使用分组计费。: Switch groups when the preferred group is unavailable; billing follows the group actually used.
translation.此处为首选分组倍率；自动切组后按实际使用分组计费，请以使用日志为准。: This is the preferred group’s multiplier. After switching, billing follows the group actually used; check usage logs.
translation.开启故障自动切组后，先使用首选分组，再按以下顺序尝试有权限的备用分组；旧 aut: With automatic fallback on, use the preferred group first, then permitted backup groups in the order below. Legacy auto tokens use the same order.
translation.新令牌默认开启故障自动切组: Enable automatic fallback by default for new tokens
translation.开启后，新建令牌默认启用自动切组；用户仍需选择首选分组，已有令牌保持原设置。: When enabled, new tokens default to automatic fallback. Users still select a preferred group; existing tokens keep their settings.
translation.自动切组顺序（也适用于旧 auto 令牌）: Automatic fallback order (also used by legacy auto tokens)
translation.新建及初始令牌默认开启故障自动切组，初始令牌以用户默认组为首选；已有令牌保持原设: Enable automatic fallback for new and initial tokens. Initial tokens prefer the user’s default group; existing tokens keep their settings.
translation.开启故障自动切组后，首选分组不可用时按配置顺序选择备用分组。: With automatic fallback enabled, select backup groups in configured order when the preferred group is unavailable.
translation.首选分组不可用时，按列表顺序尝试用户有权限的备用分组。旧 auto 令牌从列表第: When the preferred group is unavailable, try permitted backup groups in list order. Legacy auto tokens start at the first entry.
translation.默认开关只影响新建及初始令牌，不改变已有令牌；切组后按实际使用分组计费。: The default only affects new and initial tokens, not existing tokens. After switching, billing follows the group actually used.
translation.对话历史缺少思考内容: Conversation history is missing thinking content
translation.请完整回传历史思考内容，或新建会话、关闭思考模式后重试；若仍失败，请携带请求 I: Return the complete thinking history, or start a new conversation or disable thinking before retrying. If it still fails, contact the administrator with the request ID.
translation.按供应商、分组、类型、端点和标签筛选模型。: Filter models by provider, group, type, endpoint and tags.
translation.选择后立即生效，关闭后保留筛选条件。: Changes apply immediately and are kept when you close this panel.
translation.将可转赠额度生成兑换码，赠送给其他用户: Create a redemption code from transferable quota to give to another user
translation.全部分组：每个模型展示其最低适用倍率价格: All groups: each model shows its lowest applicable rate
translation.当前分组：{{group}} · 价格已包含分组倍率: Group: {{group}} · Prices include the group multiplier
translation.当前厂商无可用模型，请选择其他分组: No models for this provider; select another group
translation.阶梯计费：展示首档参考价，完整规则见详情: Tiered pricing: first-tier reference; see details for full rules
translation.请输入 JSON 对象形式的真实请求参数: Enter actual request parameters as a JSON object
translation.可选：按当前价格表达式估价: Optional: estimate with the current pricing expression
translation.扫描范围内暂无同名模型记录；不会自动生成测试视频。: No matching model records in the scanned range. No test video will be generated automatically.
translation.视频模型仅检查本地配置，不提交生成任务。: Video models only check local configuration; no generation task is submitted.
translation.视频仅进行配置预检，未生成视频，也不会改变渠道健康状态。: Video configuration checked locally. No video generated or channel health changed.
translation.视频配置预检 {{count}} 项，不计入生成成功或失败。: {{count}} video preflights, excluded from generation successes and failures.
translation.批量检查完成：真实测试成功 {{success}}，失败 {{failed}}，: Batch complete: {{success}} live tests passed, {{failed}} failed, {{preflight}} video preflights.
translation.本次仅检查本地配置，未调用上游、未产生视频生成费用；不证明凭据、参数或模型实际可: Only local configuration was checked. No upstream request or video generation charge occurred; credentials, parameters and model availability remain unverified.
translation.仅按输入参数和当前表达式估算，不验证供应商参数；不是扣费授权。上游实际成本未知，: Estimate uses entered parameters and the current expression, without validating provider parameters. It does not authorize billing. Upstream cost is unknown; a zero site price does not mean free upstream usage.
translation.仅查看最近 200 条渠道任务中的同名模型，最多展示 10 条。历史记录没有当前: Shows up to 10 matching models from the latest 200 channel tasks. Historical records were not checked against current configuration and do not prove current availability.
translation.使用当前管理员账户的分组优惠和时段倍率。修改参数后需重新估价；不保存价格，不提交: Uses the current administrator account’s group discount and time multiplier. Recalculate after parameter changes; no price is saved and no generation is submitted.
translation.填写计划使用的 duration、resolution 等请求参数；请按具体模型: Enter planned duration, resolution and other request parameters from the specific model’s documentation. There is no universal 1-second/480p default.
translation.检查配置和查看记录不生成视频。需要真实验收时，请使用正式视频 API；本页不会创: Configuration checks and history do not generate video. Use the regular video API for real acceptance testing; this page never creates paid tasks.
translation.视频模型只做配置预检，不产生生成费用；批量预检不代表视频已生成成功。其他模型仍按: Video models only run local preflights with no generation cost. Batch preflight is not generation success. Other models still make real requests to the selected endpoint.
translation.当前模型没有可本地计算的任务定价表达式: No locally calculable task pricing expression is configured for this model
translation.请选择渠道已配置的有效分组: Select a valid group configured on this channel
translation.当前参数不能完成本地估价，请检查定价表达式和请求参数: Cannot estimate locally with these parameters. Check the pricing expression and request parameters.
translation.复制失败，请手动选择模型名称复制: Copy failed. Select the model name and copy manually.
translation.令牌加载失败，请重新打开: Could not load token. Reopen this dialog.
translation.填写后使用项目端点；留空沿用 Express 模式。JSON 密钥仍使用凭据中的: Use a project endpoint when set; leave blank for Express mode. JSON credentials still use their own project.
translation.动态或不适用的价格排在末尾: Dynamic or inapplicable prices appear last
translation.请选择有效时间范围，单次导出最多 31 天: Select a valid time range of at most 31 days
translation.按当前筛选导出全部匹配日志，最多 31 天、10000 条；额度保留 quota: Export all matching logs using the current filters, up to 31 days and 10,000 rows. Amounts use quota units and times use UTC.
translation.导出失败，请缩小筛选范围后重试: Export failed. Narrow the filters and retry.
translation.导出超过 10000 条，请缩小筛选范围: More than 10,000 rows. Narrow the filters.
translation.导出文件超过 32 MB，请缩小筛选范围: Export exceeds 32 MB. Narrow the filters.
translation.日志正在导出，请稍后重试: An export is running. Try again later.
translation.暂时无法导出，请稍后重试: Export is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
translation.登录状态已变化，请刷新页面: Your login has changed. Refresh the page.
translation.例如：微信支付；留空沿用现有名称: e.g. WeChat Pay; leave blank to keep the current name
translation.仅用于余额充值入口和确认页。实际支付方式由 Stripe 后台决定；显示为微信支: Applies only to balance recharge and its confirmation. Available payment methods are managed in Stripe; confirm that Checkout supports WeChat Pay before using that label.
translation.{{method}} 最低支付金额为 US$0.50，请调整充值数量，使预计支付: The minimum {{method}} payment is US$0.50. Adjust the recharge quantity so the estimated payment is at least US$0.50.
translation.部分配置加载失败，请重试；地址暂用当前站点，模型以模型广场为准。: Some settings failed to load. Retry; the current site address is used for now. Check the model catalog for availability.
translation.地址、分组和请求样例随站点配置自动更新: Addresses, groups and request examples update automatically from site settings
translation.TTS、音色设计、音色克隆和语音识别: TTS, voice design, voice cloning and speech recognition
translation.复用上方易支付地址、商户 ID 和密钥。请先在 Epay 商户中心为每个币种和网: Uses the Epay URL, merchant ID and key above. In Epay, test a BEpusdt payment for each coin and network, enable it and set it as the default for that combination before turning on its switch.
translation.订单按人民币计价，客户使用所选网络的 USDT 或 USDC 付款。BEpusd: Orders are priced in CNY. Customers pay USDT or USDC on the selected network. Configure BEpusdt, wallets and token contracts in Epay / the gateway; tokens with the same symbol on different chains may not be interchangeable.
translation.订单以人民币计价。请使用 {{network}} 网络支付 {{coin}}，并: Orders are priced in CNY. Pay {{coin}} on {{network}} and check the token contract, address and exact amount at checkout. Your order updates after confirmation. Do not use another network or transfer twice.
translation.充值方式设置须为 JSON 数组，且每项的 type 及其他字段均为字符串: Payment methods must be a JSON array with string values for type and all other fields.
translation.复用上方易支付地址、商户 ID 和密钥。请先在 Epay 商户中心完成 BEpu: Uses the Epay URL, merchant ID and key above. First complete a BEpusdt payment test in the Epay merchant portal, then enable it as the default USDT channel.
translation.订单按人民币计价，客户使用 USDT / TRC20 付款，资金进入商户钱包。B: Orders are priced in CNY. Customers pay USDT on TRC20 directly to the merchant wallet. Configure the BEpusdt URL, API Token and wallet in Epay, not here.
translation.开关与充值方式设置同步，保存后同时用于余额充值和套餐购买；关闭不影响已创建订单的: The switch updates the payment methods configuration. Once saved, it applies to balance top-ups and plan purchases. Disabling it does not block payment notifications for existing orders.
translation.订单以人民币计价。请在收银台使用 TRC20 网络，按显示的地址和精确 USDT: Orders are priced in CNY. At checkout, use the TRC20 network and the exact address and USDT amount shown. Your order updates after payment confirmation. Do not transfer twice.
translation.暂无可用收藏，请先选择并收藏分组: No available favorites. Select and favorite a group first.
translation.无法保存收藏，关闭页面后可能丢失: Unable to save favorites; they may be lost when this page closes.
translation.收藏仅保存在当前浏览器，按账号隔离: Favorites are stored in this browser, separately for each account.
translation.作用于 /v1/responses、/v1/chat/completions、/: Applies to /v1/responses, /v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages and compatible paths, limiting the complete decompressed request body. 0 disables this precheck; global, Nginx and upstream limits still apply.
translation.开启后仅记录上游安全拒绝，不执行本站冷静期、不发送处罚警告、不新增自动复核单；上: When enabled, upstream safety rejections are recorded only, without local cooldowns, penalty warnings, or new automatic review cases. Upstream safety policies and manual account disabling still apply.
translation.移出白名单后恢复原有规则，尚未到期的历史冷静期可能重新生效。: Removing a user from the whitelist restores the original rules; any unexpired previous cooldown may apply again.
translation.白名单状态读取失败或后端尚不支持，请刷新或升级后重试。: Whitelist status could not be loaded or is not supported by the server. Refresh or upgrade and try again.
translation.可直接重发已保存的发票、明细账单和产品明细清单，支持修改收件邮箱。未保存的附件需: Resend the saved invoice, detailed bill, and product item list directly, with an optional recipient change. Upload any unsaved attachments once to reuse them in future resends.
translation.将复用已保存的 PDF；如需更换，可上传新文件。: The saved PDF will be reused. Upload a new file only to replace it.
translation.尚未保存此附件，请上传一次；之后重发可直接复用。: This attachment has not been saved. Upload it once to reuse it in future resends.
translation.尚未保存明细账单 PDF，请上传一次后再重发: No detailed bill PDF is saved. Upload it once before resending.
translation.尚未保存产品明细清单 PDF，请上传一次后再重发: No product item list PDF is saved. Upload it once before resending.
translation.已保存的明细账单 PDF 无法读取，请重新上传: The saved detailed bill PDF cannot be read. Please upload it again.
translation.已保存的产品明细清单 PDF 无法读取，请重新上传: The saved product item list PDF cannot be read. Please upload it again.
translation.已保存的明细账单 PDF 无效，请重新上传: The saved detailed bill PDF is invalid. Please upload it again.
translation.已保存的产品明细清单 PDF 无效，请重新上传: The saved product item list PDF is invalid. Please upload it again.
translation.明细账单附件仅支持有效 PDF 文件: The detailed bill attachment must be a valid PDF.
translation.产品明细清单附件仅支持有效 PDF 文件: The product item list attachment must be a valid PDF.
translation.明细账单文件名不能超过 255 个字符: The detailed bill filename cannot exceed 255 characters.
translation.产品明细清单文件名不能超过 255 个字符: The product item list filename cannot exceed 255 characters.
translation.Stripe 最低支付金额为 US$0.50，请调整充值数量，使预计支付金额不低: The minimum Stripe payment is US$0.50. Adjust the recharge quantity so the estimated payment is at least US$0.50.
translation.拖动手柄调整顺序，也可使用上下按钮或方向键。: Drag the handle to reorder, or use the up/down buttons or arrow keys.
translation.操作已成功，但列表刷新失败，请手动刷新: The operation succeeded, but the list could not refresh. Please refresh manually.
translation.已处理上游模型更新：加入 {{added}} 个，删除 {{removed}}: Upstream models updated: {{added}} added, {{removed}} removed; unchecked items remain pending.
translation.未勾选的模型保持待处理，不会自动忽略。: Unchecked models remain pending and are not automatically ignored.
translation.客户端已断开连接；请检查是否主动停止、客户端超时或网络中断。: The client disconnected; check for a manual stop, client timeout, or network interruption.
translation.上游声明与请求或映射模型不匹配，仅供排查，不影响计费。: The provider declaration does not match the requested or mapped model. Diagnostic only; billing is unchanged.
translation.模型名称来自上游声明，不能据此验证实际模型身份。: The model name is declared by the provider and does not verify the underlying model identity.
translation.输入渠道名称关键词，或用逗号分隔多个渠道 ID: Enter a channel name keyword, or separate multiple channel IDs with commas
translation.按当前名称查找，选中后参与查询；含禁用渠道，旧渠道可输入 ID。: Search current names, then select. Includes disabled channels; enter an ID for historical channels.
translation.请先选择匹配渠道，或清空渠道搜索。: Select matching channels or clear the channel search first.
translation.按当前筛选和完整时间范围汇总消费记录，不受日志分页影响；失败、退款等记录不计入。: Summarizes consumption records for current filters and the entire time range, independent of pagination. Failure and refund records are excluded.
translation.额度与缓存率仅统计消费记录；缓存率可能取最近样本，RPM/TPM 为所选范围内最: Quota and cache rates use consumption records only. Cache rates may be sampled. RPM/TPM measure the last 60 seconds intersected with the selected range.
translation.尚未配置 Redis 连接，生产环境自动发奖需要 Redis 提供防重放保护。: No Redis connection is configured. Automatic rewards in production require Redis for replay prevention.
translation.不同用途必须使用不同密钥，并与 Pulse 或社区插件的对应字段保持一致。只在缺: Use a different secret for each purpose and match the corresponding Pulse or community plugin field. Generate only when a secret is missing or you intend to rotate it.
translation.为 Pulse 消费统计保留日志，生产环境请启用。: Keep usage logs for Pulse statistics. Enable this in production.
translation.为此用途生成新密钥: Generate a secret for this purpose
translation.保存后在当前实例即时生效，无需重建容器；其他实例将在配置同步后生效（默认约 60: Changes apply immediately to this instance without recreating containers. Other instances apply them after configuration sync (about 60 seconds by default). Unchanged settings stay in place; secrets remain hidden and blank fields preserve them.
translation.先完成密钥、限额和奖池配置，再启用此开关。Pulse 侧还需关闭影子模式并启用动: Configure secrets, limits, and the prize pool before enabling this. In Pulse, also disable shadow mode and enable actions.
translation.留空保留现有密钥: Leave blank to keep the existing secret
translation.请先复制并同步到对应服务，再填入此字段并保存。此密钥仅用于当前用途，保存后不会再: Copy this secret to the corresponding service first, then use it in this field and save. It is only for this purpose and will not be shown after saving.
translation.轮换期间可填写上一组密钥以兼容尚未同步的服务。同步完成后勾选清除并保存，结束旧密: During rotation, enter the previous secret to support services that have not synced yet. After syncing, select clear and save to stop accepting the old secret.
translation.限额填写内部 quota，不是人民币。每 1 API 额度单位 = {{quot: Enter limits in internal quota, not CNY. 1 API quota unit = {{quota}} quota. Daily limits use Beijing calendar days; rolling back rewards does not restore the day's allowance.
translation.历史错误记录可能来自重试，不能据此判断最终调用结果。: Historical error records may be retry attempts and do not establish the final request outcome.
translation.记录请求最终失败，用户可查看原因和排查信息；自动重试成功不会记为失败。: Record final request failures with troubleshooting details. Successful automatic retries are not logged as failures.
translation.HTTP 200 仅表示响应已开始，流内错误仍代表调用失败。: HTTP 200 only means the response started; an error inside the stream still indicates failure.
translation.费用请以相同 Request ID 下的消费或退款记录为准。: Check usage or refund entries with the same Request ID for actual charges.
translation.请求被内容安全策略拒绝: Request rejected by the content safety policy
translation.请调整请求内容，遵守使用政策；处于冷静期时请等待结束。: Revise the request to comply with usage policies. Wait for any cooldown to end.
translation.对话上下文已失效: Conversation context is no longer available
translation.请新建会话并重新发送完整上下文。: Start a new conversation and resend the full context.
translation.账户或令牌额度不足: Account or token quota is insufficient
translation.请检查账户余额、令牌额度及套餐限制。: Check your balance, token quota, and plan limits.
translation.请求体超过大小限制: Request body exceeds the size limit
translation.请减少消息、附件或图片大小后重试。: Reduce the size of messages, attachments, or images and retry.
translation.请求受到限流或并发限制: Request hit a rate or concurrency limit
translation.请按 Retry-After 等待，降低并发后重试。: Wait as directed by Retry-After, reduce concurrency, and retry.
translation.请稍后重试；若持续超时，请携带请求 ID 联系管理员。: Retry later. If timeouts persist, contact the administrator with the Request ID.
translation.请联系管理员检查上游渠道配置。: Contact the administrator to check the upstream channel configuration.
translation.API 密钥无效、过期或已停用: API key is invalid, expired, or disabled
translation.请检查所用令牌的状态、有效期和额度。: Check the token's status, expiry date, and quota.
translation.当前请求没有访问权限: Access is not permitted for this request
translation.请检查令牌的模型、分组和 IP 限制。: Check the token's model, group, and IP restrictions.
translation.当前模型服务暂不可用: The model service is temporarily unavailable
translation.请稍后重试或选择其他可用模型、分组。: Retry later or choose another available model or group.
translation.当前令牌可用范围内未找到该模型: The model was not found within this token's permitted scope
translation.请使用同一令牌查询 /v1/models，核对模型名称、令牌分组及渠道限制。: Use the same token to query /v1/models and check the model name, token group, and channel restrictions.
translation.上游模型不支持当前采样参数: The upstream model does not support this sampling parameter
translation.请关闭客户端自定义 temperature 参数后重试；若仍失败，请携带请求 I: Disable the custom temperature parameter in your client and retry. If it still fails, contact the administrator with the Request ID.
translation.请关闭客户端自定义 top_p 参数后重试；若仍失败，请携带请求 ID 联系管理: Disable the custom top_p parameter in your client and retry. If it still fails, contact the administrator with the Request ID.
translation.请关闭客户端自定义 top_k 参数后重试；若仍失败，请携带请求 ID 联系管理: Disable the custom top_k parameter in your client and retry. If it still fails, contact the administrator with the Request ID.

### ⚠️ High-Risk Operation: Risk Notice and Disclaimer for 504/524 Retry
By default, this project does not retry for status codes `400` (bad request), `504` (gateway timeout), and `524` (timeout occurred).
 In many cases, 504 and 524 mean the request has reached the upstream AI service and processing has started, but the connection was closed due to long processing time.

Enabling redirection/retry for these timeout status codes is a **high-risk operation**. Before enabling it, you must read and understand the consequences below:

#### 1. Core Risks (Read Carefully)
1. 💸 Duplicate/multiple billing risk: Most upstream AI providers **still charge** for requests that started processing but got interrupted by network timeout (504/524). If retry is triggered, a new upstream request will be sent, which can lead to **duplicate or multiple charges**.
2. ⏳ Severe client timeout: If a single request already timed out, adding retries can multiply total latency and cause severe or unacceptable timeout behavior for your final client/caller.
3. 💥 Request backlog and system crash risk: Forcing retries on timeout requests keeps threads and connections occupied for longer. Under high concurrency, this can cause serious backlog, exhaust system resources, trigger a cascading failure, and crash your proxy service.

#### 2. Risk Acknowledgement
If you still choose to enable this feature, you acknowledge all of the following:
